cues.text: Footage from a security camera looks down on a lounge in the dorm, with tables, chairs and a vending machine. Koromaru trots out into the room and turns around to face the camera.
Fuuka, Aigis and Yukari walk into view and stop a few steps from Koromaru.
Aigis walks over to stand beside Koromaru and looks straight up at the camera.
Yukari and Fuuka spin around and stare up at the camera.
Yukari, furious, turns on her heel and storms off, and Fuuka hurries after her, leaving Aigis and Koromaru under the camera.
